label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: What is not begins to be only through something that…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., tertia via: quod non est, non incipit esse nisi per aliquid quod est
interpretation: Interval reading, as the next clause uses it ('si igitur nihil fuit ens, impossibile fuit quod aliquid inciperet esse'): what is not at an earlier time and is at a later one began through something that was at the earlier time. A local reading (the cause is when the effect begins) gives the conclusion only with a further assumption about the order of time and is not formalized.
